name: IM-1 Odysseus
note: LROC point; landed ~1.5 km from its Malapert A target and tipped over.

name: IM-2 Athena
note: Point is the published TARGET (LROC). The lander ended ~250 m away, on its side in a crater (collectSPACE).

name: Chandrayaan-3 Vikram + Pragyan
note: Widely quoted Shiv Shakti point; not read on an ISRO or LROC page, so drawn with a 1.5 km circle.

name: Luna-25 impact crater
note: LROC: ~10 m crater, position better than 40 m. Far outside the polar view.

name: Chandrayaan-1 Moon Impact Probe (Stooke et al. 2021)
note: Stooke et al. 2021 (LPSC abstract 1013): MIP frames matched to LROC; lower slope of the Shackleton-de Gerlache ridge.

name: IM-4 with ESA PROSPECT
note: ESA gives ~84.5S 31.5E 'to be confirmed'. 5-10 Earth days of operations.

name: LUPEX / Chandrayaan-5
note: South pole; no site announced. Not placed on the map.

name: MoonFall (4 JPL hopping drones)
note: South pole, surveying Artemis regions; no site announced. Not placed on the map.
